text: 中国上证综指9月11日（周五）收盘下跌46.29点，跌幅：1.18%，报3888.11点；中国深证成指9月11日（周五）收盘下跌146.41点，跌幅：1.08%，报13471.26点；中国沪深300指数9月11日（周五）收盘下跌38.23点，跌幅：0.84%，报4510.16点；中国创业板指数9月11日（周五）收盘下跌16.38点，跌幅：0.49%，报3322.04点；中国科创50指数9月11日（周五）收盘下跌15.83点，跌幅：1.01%，报1553.39点。
text_en: The Shanghai Composite Index closed on Friday, September 11, down 46.29 points, or 1.18%, at 3,888.11; the Shenzhen Component Index closed on Friday, September 11, down 146.41 points, or 1.08%, at 13,471.26; the CSI 300 Index closed on Friday, September 11, down 38.23 points, or 0.84%, at 4,510.16; the ChiNext Index closed on Friday, September 11, down 16.38 points, or 0.49%, at 3,322.04; the STAR 50 Index closed on Friday, September 11, down 15.83 points, or 1.01%, at 1,553.39.
